content.user_title: Manage Portfolio Risk and Trade Exposure
content.value_statement: Trading decisions can hide concentration, drawdown, and position sizing risk. This skill structures risk reviews, R-multiple tracking, hedging plans, and stop-loss discipline.
actual_capabilities: Guides position sizing based on account risk percentage and defined stop levels.
Structures R-multiple trade tracking and expectancy calculations.
Supports VaR, beta, correlation, drawdown, and stress test analysis.
Produces risk assessment reports, dashboard templates, and tracking spreadsheet outlines.
Recommends systematic stops, take-profit levels, hedges, and portfolio risk limits.
limitations: It does not provide regulated financial advice or guarantee trading outcomes.
It requires accurate portfolio, trade, price, and volatility data from the user.
It does not connect to brokerages, exchanges, or live market feeds.
Advanced simulations and derivative valuations may need external tools or specialist review.

use_cases.title: Review Trade Risk Before Entry
use_cases.description: Estimate position size, max loss, R-multiple targets, and stop placement before placing a trade.

use_cases.title: Monitor Portfolio Concentration
use_cases.description: Check correlations, beta exposure, drawdown risk, and position limits across an existing portfolio.

use_cases.title: Build Risk Reporting Workflows
use_cases.description: Create repeatable reports for expectancy, stress scenarios, hedging options, and risk dashboards.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Risk Snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this portfolio for basic risk. Include concentration, max drawdown concerns, missing data, and immediate risk controls: [paste holdings and account size].

prompt_templates.title: Size a Trade by R-Multiple
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate position size for this trade using R-multiple risk. Account size: [amount]. Risk per trade: [percent]. Entry: [price]. Stop: [price]. Target: [price].

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Portfolio Correlation
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess correlation and concentration risk for these positions. Identify overlapping exposures, beta risk, and suggested position limits: [paste holdings and sector data].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Stress Test and Hedge Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a stress test and hedge plan for this portfolio. Include scenarios, expected losses, hedge candidates, stop rules, and monitoring metrics: [paste portfolio data].

output_examples.input: Assess a 50,000 account risking 1 percent on a trade with entry 100 and stop 95.
output: Position size: 100 shares if the stop distance is 5 per share.
A target at 110 gives a 2R potential gain before fees and slippage.

output_examples.input: Review a portfolio concentrated in large technology stocks.
output: Primary risk: correlated equity exposure during broad market selloffs.
Suggested checks: beta, sector weight, max drawdown, and shared revenue drivers.
Possible controls: reduce overlap, add explicit position limits, or evaluate hedges.

output_examples.input: Create a risk report for recent trades with win rate and average win-loss data.
output: The report would summarize expectancy, average R, drawdown, and rule adherence.
It would flag whether losses exceed planned 1R limits.
It would recommend changes to sizing, stop discipline, or trade selection.

best_practices: Provide account value, holdings, entry prices, stop levels, targets, and current exposure.
Review risk in R terms before focusing on profit targets.
Recheck correlations and exposure after each material portfolio change.
anti_patterns: Treating hedge recommendations as guaranteed protection.
Sizing positions without stop levels or account risk limits.
Using stale price, volatility, or correlation data for risk decisions.

faq.question: Does this skill give financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure risk analysis, but users must make their own decisions and seek qualified advice when needed.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide account size, holdings, entry prices, stop levels, targets, position values, and any available volatility or correlation data.

faq.question: Can it calculate position size?
faq.answer: Yes. It can calculate position size when account risk, entry price, stop price, and risk percentage are provided.

faq.question: Can it build a hedge plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline hedge candidates, scenarios, monitoring metrics, and tradeoffs based on the portfolio data supplied.

faq.question: Does it use live market prices?
faq.answer: No. It relies on user-provided data unless the host environment gives access to separate market data tools.
